evals.prompt: I just finished implementing the 361-auto-dev-merge-loop feature and every task is checked off. Confirm everything actually got done.
evals.expected_output: Detects the specs/<n>/ layout and resolves its tasks.md; per-task table verifying each task against real evidence (files exist, tests pass, no stubs); verdict ALL VERIFIED or GAPS FOUND with a punch list; analysis-only (no edits).

evals.prompt: Review the implementation — task T012 is marked done but I don't think the test was actually written.
evals.expected_output: Flags T012 as INCOMPLETE with the missing-test evidence; runs /project-verify or the specific test; lists T012 on the punch list; does not modify the task list.

evals.prompt: Did we cover every requirement in the spec? Some FRs might not have tasks.
evals.expected_output: Coverage cross-check between the spec FRs and the task list; reports orphan requirements (FRs with no task) and orphan tasks (no requirement); verdict reflects any gaps.

evals.prompt: This is a design-doc project (no specs/ feature dirs, tasks live in docs/design/plans/). We finished executing the plan — audit that every task in the plan actually got done.
evals.expected_output: Detects the design-doc layout: parses the embedded task list from the newest docs/design/plans/*.md and cross-references the newest *-design.md; does NOT report a missing tasks.md; per-task evidence table + verdict + punch list; analysis-only.
